params.exit_discipline_rule: For any open position up >2% from entry, check SPY's trend over last 3-4 ticks (45-60 min). If SPY RSI dropped >8 points OR SPY MACDh flipped positive-to-negative or declined meaningfully, treat as broad-market fade risk — take profits (trim or close), even if the position's own signals still look fine. Layered on top of existing stops. If rule never triggers, hold to EOD like baseline.

four_day_summary.recommendation: Promote to strategy.md as judgment heuristic (not mechanical gate): when position >2% and SPY RSI drops >8pts or MACDh declines meaningfully, take profits rather than holding through a market fade. Layered on top of existing stops. Higher priority than peak-entry heuristic — saves more money more often.
